title: Audit Radio filter visual depth
description: Audit Radio for option layout, selected indicator, icon support, single-choice semantics, keyboard behavior, and field binding.
objective: Make Radio distinct from Checkbox and Chips where behavior and visual affordance differ.
acceptance_criteria: The audit distinguishes radio semantics from checkbox multi-select and chip visual style.
The audit identifies missing controls for indicator shape, size, color, icon, spacing, and selected state.
The audit checks value reset behavior and URL sync implications.
The audit ties radio values to option parsing and field binding.
verification: Source-backed findings cite render, CSS, JS, and control IDs.
No Radio implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: radio audit, render, CSS, option parsing

risks: Radio can become visually redundant with Chips unless selected affordance and semantics are separated.
